title: Secretary of State of New Mexico

context.text: The seat is open: Secretary of State Maggie Toulouse Oliver cannot run again after two consecutive terms and is running in the Democratic primary for lieutenant governor.
In the June 2 Democratic primary, Doña Ana County Clerk Amanda López Askin defeated Santa Fe County Clerk Katharine Clark 53.0% to 47.0%. Ramona Goolsby was unopposed in the Republican primary.
The New Mexico Secretary of State's 2026 General Election candidate list shows two candidates for Secretary of State: Amanda López Askin and Ramona L. Goolsby.

candidates.name: Amanda López Askin
candidates.ballotNote: Won the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary over Katharine Clark.

priorities.text: Keep elections running smoothly and build public trust by addressing election misinformation early.
Protect New Mexicans' private voter information from federal overreach.
Fully implement the Native American Voting Rights Act provisions and fund county clerks.

statements.quote: You cannot register to vote without having proven through several sources who you are.
statements.context: Source NM interview, in answer to a question about photo ID to register; she did not address proof of citizenship

record.text: Has served as Doña Ana County Clerk since 2018 and has run 12 elections, including a period in which she received a death threat from a former candidate later arrested for organizing shootings, per Source NM.

candidates.name: Ramona Goolsby
candidates.ballotNote: Advanced unopposed from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary.
candidates.currentRole: Board member, Ciudad Soil and Water Conservation District; family nurse practitioner

priorities.text: Secure, accurate and transparent elections, including voter ID and regular cleaning of voter rolls.
Enforce campaign finance and lobbying laws fairly and consistently.
Modernize and streamline business registration; run the office with professionalism and respect for taxpayer dollars.

statements.quote: Support commonsense voter ID so New Mexicans can have confidence that every ballot is tied to an eligible voter.
statements.context: On her campaign site; she does not address documentary proof of citizenship
